integrity: All strict global comparisons within the claimed family follow analytically from the displayed conditioning and derivative inequalities; the finite checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Optimality is restricted to two reflection-paired observation locations; arbitrary asymmetric pairs are not covered.
Observations have independent centered Gaussian errors and continuously divisible nonnegative precision.
No higher-dimensional, adaptive, multi-channel, unknown-covariance, or fixed setup-cost claim is made.
Historical originality is based on inspected and searchable literature, not an exhaustive priority proof.
title: Sharp replication-to-separation transition in symmetric Gaussian-kernel quadrature
